status: design inputs only; not an applied game configuration
assumptions: One harvest/replant session every 24 hours, every simulated day; each is watered immediately, and initial six plants are mature on day one.
Every rewarded fish attempt succeeds; no paid bait, processing, crop quality or additional main modes.
Main players finish one eligible main daily each day; no missed days or grace days are simulated.
A fixed house bonus is an input, not a simulation of obtaining or arranging furniture.
Sell all surplus; orders consume five crops and five fish with two species each, once each week, and pay their base value plus the stated bonus.
Try weekly orders on days 7, 14, 21 and 28 only; rare same-species failures are recorded, not magically fulfilled.
Buy land as soon as affordable while reserving the current day's seed budget; ignore house/tool/decor spending and duplicate-roll income.
Discovery-track seeds are claimed and planted first; regular mystery seeds have static odds and no hidden pity counter.
Claimed free seeds and unplanted milestone seeds carry in inventory; only unused dated catch allowance expires.
Rarity labels and prices are game design hypotheses, not botanical scarcity or ecological classifications.
Eight species per pool are arithmetic placeholders, not the intended final collection size.
